title: refactor(app-shell): the metadata-admin previews and object inspector pick with the shared Select (objectui#11865)
body:
Part of #11865

Clause-②: no

Four metadata-admin pickers were browser-native select elements beside the shared Radix `Select` (`packages/components/src/ui/select`) that the rest of the designer picks with. They now use the shared `Select`, as the card's earlier slices did (objectui#11934 through objectui#12013). This PR is slice l of claim `6071773793` and names the files it converts:

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/PagePreview.tsx`: a record page preview's sample-record picker, through one module-private `SampleRecordPicker`.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/DocPreview.tsx`: a doc's book-section picker, through one module-private `BookSectionPicker`. Each book is a `SelectGroup` headed by a `SelectLabel`, where the native control had an optgroup.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/ActionPreview.tsx`: the select-param mock in an action's input-dialog preview. The dialog it mocks draws that param with `SelectField`, which is the same primitive.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ObjectDefaultInspector.tsx`: the object designer's access posture (`access.default`).

**Premise correction: two of the six files on the slice had no native select.**
- `ViewVariantInspector.tsx` and `ReportDefaultInspector.tsx` already pick their type through `InspectorSelectField`, which is the shared `Select`.
- The census matched a one-line docblock in each (`Build the View-type` / `Report-type` select-tag options), not a control.
- This PR rewords those two comments to name the picker, so a re-run of that census no longer counts them. The shipped bytes are identical: both files' console chunks keep the same content-hashed names on base and head (`ViewVariantInspector-CqGDfUrN.js`, `ReportDefaultInspector-CVYJaOF2.js`).

No prop, export or `packages/i18n` key changes. `ViewConfigPanel.tsx`, `ReportConfigPanel.tsx`, `packages/components/src/ui/**` and the sibling slices' files are untouched.

## What each picker writes is unchanged (H1)

Before the first edit, a scratch probe (deleted, never committed) mounted each component on base `5d77c099b`, fired a `change` on every native option and recorded what it wrote. The new pins compare each pick against those literals as JSON text, with a key that holds `undefined` named.

| Picker | Rows | What a pick does |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Sample record | 4 samples (ids from `id`, `_id`, `name`) | binds the same record context (object, record id, name) |
| Book section | 16 (doc with no section, with `reference`, with a key no book declares) | `{"group":"KEY"}`, and "Not placed in a section" writes `group` as `undefined`. A key two books share writes the same patch from either book |
| Access posture | 8 (no access, `private`, explicit `public`, off-spec value) | "Private" writes `{"access":{"default":"private"}}`, "Public" writes `access` as `undefined` |
| Action-param mock | 4 params | writes nothing: it is disabled, as before, and has no handler |

Re-picking the option a trigger already shows writes nothing. The probe's test DOM fired `change` for that case too, but a browser's native select does not, so those rows pin the primitive's behaviour.

## Names, read-only and keyboard (H2)

- **Book section** keeps the name its label `htmlFor` gave the native control ("Book section"): the `id` moved onto the trigger.
- **Sample record, access posture and the mock** had no accessible name on base (a `span` caption, a `Label` with no `htmlFor`, a `label` that wraps no control) and keep none, as dispatched.
- **Read-only:** the book section (`editing` off) and the posture (`readOnly`) disable the trigger, now in the primitive's own disabled look (objectui#11781). The sample-record picker writes no metadata and has no read-only state. The mock is always disabled.
- **Keyboard:** Enter opens and Enter on an option selects. This is pinned for the sample record, the book section and the posture.

## A value outside the options (H3)

- **Book section:** a stored key no option carries now shows in the trigger. With the books listed it reads "KEY (not a section of any book)", as the native extra option did. While the books load, or after they fail to, it shows the key itself. In those two states the native control showed "Not placed in a section". This is the one display change.
- **Sample record:** a chosen id that the samples no longer carry (the page was bound to another object since) shows the first sample. The preview renders that sample, and the native control showed it too. This is pinned as base behaviour, not changed.
- **Access posture:** the shown posture is derived (`private` only for `access.default === 'private'`, else `public`), so no outside value can reach it, on base or head.
- **Mock:** it always shows its placeholder, on base and head.

## First-load bytes (H4)

Measured with `apps/console` `CI=true pnpm exec vite build` under the verify lock, from `dist/eager-closure.json`:

- **Base `5d77c099b`:** `eagerGzipBytes` 3,235,851 (raw 10,889,025, 289 eager chunks).
- **Head:** `eagerGzipBytes` 3,235,844 (raw 10,889,025, 289 eager chunks). It was built at `5e66d5369`; the one later commit, `a5224d2f1`, changes a test file only.
- **Delta:** −7 B gzip, 0 B raw.
- **Where the files ship:** the four converted files are in the lazy `register-builtin-designers` chunk, measured on base before the first edit, which is not among the eager members. That chunk goes from 488.83 kB to 489.46 kB raw.
- **Eager members that move:** only the entry (−8 B gzip, because it names the lazy chunk's new hash) and `src` (+1 B gzip), both at 0 B raw.

## Tests

**Four new suites, 45 tests:**
- `PagePreview.sharedSelect-11865` (8);
- `DocPreview.sharedSelect-11865` (23);
- `ActionPreview.sharedSelect-11865` (3);
- `ObjectDefaultInspector.sharedSelect-11865` (11).

**Five suites that drove the native controls now pick through the trigger and its listbox.** Each still checks the same thing:
- `DocPreview.test.tsx`;
- `ResourceEditPage.docEditor-10188.test.tsx`, which mounts `DocPreview` through the edit page;
- `ObjectDefaultInspector.test.tsx`: a read of the native `value` is now a read of the trigger's whole text;
- `ActionDesigner.paramVocabulary.test.tsx`: its control-kind reader now counts a combobox that pops no dialog as `select`, the kind it already counted a native select as;
- `dataPreviews.i18n-10862-s3.test.tsx`: it opens the sample-record picker before reading the item labels, which a closed `Select` keeps off the page.

**Reverse leg, on committed `5e66d5369`:**
- The four source files were put back on their base blobs, and each disk hash was proven equal to the base blob before the run.
- The new suites went red 44 of 45. The green one is "opens nothing, so it writes nothing": a disabled native mock opens no listbox either.
- The five converted suites went red in exactly the 10 tests whose code this PR changed.
- `paramVocabulary` stayed green (19), by design: it asserts the control kind, which both primitives satisfy.
- Restore: `git checkout HEAD` on the four paths. Each disk hash then equalled its HEAD blob, and `git diff HEAD` was empty.

## Gates

Final head `a5224d2f1` (`git rev-parse --short HEAD` after the last commit).

- **vitest, repo root, on `5e66d5369`:** the 52 metadata-admin suites that mount these components (directly, or through `registerBuiltinInspectors` / `Previews` / `Designers` or `MetadataResourceEditPage`), plus the four new suites: `Test Files 56 passed (56)`, `Tests 486 passed (486)`. The 38 other mounting suites (Studio, console, app-shell): `Test Files 38 passed (38)`, `Tests 378 passed (378)`. The two repo-wide pins: `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 18 passed (18)`.
- **Narrowing to `a5224d2f1`, declared:** `5e66d5369..a5224d2f1` is one line of `DocPreview.sharedSelect-11865.test.tsx` (a fourth `it.each` parameter), and no other file imports it. On `a5224d2f1` these ran green: the four new suites (`Tests 45 passed (45)`), and the two repo-wide pins with `DocPreview.sharedSelect-11865`, `DocPreview.test` and `ResourceEditPage.docEditor-10188` (`Test Files 5 passed (5)`, `Tests 57 passed (57)`).
- **type-check:** `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) exits 0 on `a5224d2f1`, run after `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' run build` (`Scope: 29 of 47 workspace projects`, exit 0). `--listFilesOnly`: the four sources are in the main program, and all 15 touched `.ts`/`.tsx` files are in the test program.
- **eslint** on the 15 touched `.ts`/`.tsx` files: exit 0, 0 errors and 21 warnings. Every modified file's per-rule counts equal its base blob's, and the four new suites have 0.
- **Light gates, exit 0 on `a5224d2f1`:**
  - `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: "15 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)";
  - `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`;
  - `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: "0 new citation(s)";
  - `pnpm check:control-bytes`.
- **Also exit 0:** `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:metadata-write-doors` and `check:i18n-keys`. `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over the 16 paths prints NOT GOVERNED.
- **Changeset:** `@object-ui/app-shell: patch`. No README or `content/docs` sentence names these four controls (`git grep`), so there is no doc to patch.

## Acceptance notes

All `carrier: none`:
- The sample-record picker, the access posture and the action-param mock have no accessible name, on base as now.
- The action-param mock shows its placeholder even when the param declares a `defaultValue`. `ActionParamDialog` seeds `defaultValue` into the dialog's values, so the preview and the dialog can differ there. This was read from source on the dialog side, measured only on the mock, and is the same on base.
- The card's census counted `ViewVariantInspector` and `ReportDefaultInspector` from a single-line docblock. Its comment filter did not drop a `/** … */` line.
